observations.statement: The glossary makes `Puppet Master` the only platform name and permits `legacy naming` as the sole reference to older names.

The canonical rewrite vocabulary defines execution context, concern lineage, trust and degraded states, three help layers, and worktree owner lineage, and requires those names verbatim across Orchestrator, inspectors, and recovery surfaces.
For `provider_unavailable`, runtime behavior is fallback to the next eligible provider in priority order; exhaustion requires the UI to surface provider health, auth, and recovery guidance.

A browser automation handoff pauses the live session, focuses the exact tab and step, enters `attention_required`, and permits continuation only from the paused pointer or an explicit retry of the current repro step.
Route Target, OpenSubject, Runtime Identity, Account Switch Lineage, and Artifact establish shared routing, persistence, audit, and execution-attribution concepts.
Terminal Section, Tab, Pane, Session, and Dev Session are distinct ownership levels; exact PTY reuse remains keyed by `terminal_session_id`, not `dev_session_id`.

Remote projections are intended to keep freshness, health, and write availability separate, while route/open and mutation gating uses projection freshness plus projection health and excludes `trust_tier`.
The help/status model enumerates project activity and attention states, blocked-owner classes, a deterministic escalation ladder, and aging-driven resurfacing.

User-facing operation copy distinguishes review contexts, mandates requested/effective labels, separates health/capability/readiness/validation, and assigns distinct meanings to retry/resume/recover/restore.
SessionStore makes seglog canonical, redb and search material disposable projections, replay deterministic at `target_seq`, and committed projection state the source for freshness notifications.

Instant Grep is the user-facing name for SparseNgramIndex-backed regex acceleration; the index narrows candidates, ripgrep verifies matches, DirtyLayer covers dirty paths, and keyword/symbol search remains in separate domains.
The glossary owns short canonical terminology and negative constraints, and the visible G-002 PlanUnit marks that owner requirement accepted, GUI-related, unsplit, and dependency-free.

candidate_findings.summary: The capsule defines two incompatible canonical help-entry shapes.
candidate_findings.obligation: Runtime/routing help entries must use a durable canonical record and preserve the same terminology across inline, context, and full-help views.
candidate_findings.gap: One shape requires `canonical_name`, `short_definition`, `why_it_matters`, `what_it_is_not`, `common_related_states`, `related_concepts`, and `surface_examples`; the later canonical template instead uses Title, Canonical definition, appearance/context, recovery, escalation, related concepts, and evidence links. No field mapping, requiredness rule, key, version, or migration contract reconciles them.

candidate_findings.summary: Trust, freshness, and health state vocabularies are internally incompatible.
candidate_findings.obligation: Action gating must use separately represented freshness and health, with write availability separate and `trust_tier` excluded.
candidate_findings.gap: Remote-state freshness is `current|refreshing|stale` and health is `healthy|degraded|unavailable`, while later Projection Freshness is `fresh|warm|stale|expired` and Projection Health is `healthy|degraded|blocked|unknown`; the earlier Trust State additionally mixes `readable`, `writable`, `degraded`, and `blocked` into one decision. No canonical enum, mapping, precedence, or serialization rule is supplied.

candidate_findings.summary: The persistence vocabulary revives a tier-shaped runtime record that the rewrite rules classify as compatibility-only.
candidate_findings.obligation: Tier-shaped terms must remain migration aliases and be mapped to node, attempt, package, seam, lane, worktree, or Orchestrator-tab owners before use in live payloads.
candidate_findings.gap: SessionStore nevertheless distinguishes a canonical-looking `tier_runtime_record` and says glossary terms name persistence records consistently, without marking that record compatibility-only or defining its mapping to current identity.

candidate_findings.summary: Side-effect route resolution leaves security- and destination-critical behavior to builders.
candidate_findings.obligation: A Route Target must be resolved through a cascading resolver and permission checks before output or side effects occur.
candidate_findings.gap: The capsule does not specify scheme allowlisting, resolver order, URI canonicalization, fallback boundaries, permission-check timing, denial results, ambiguity handling, or mutation atomicity, so different implementations can select or authorize different destinations.

candidate_findings.summary: Provider fallback lacks an executable selection and disclosure contract.
candidate_findings.obligation: On `provider_unavailable`, runtime must select the next eligible provider in priority order and expose health, auth, and recovery guidance if none exists while preserving requested/effective identity semantics.
candidate_findings.gap: Eligibility predicates, priority authority, tie-breaking, retry bounds, account/auth interaction, side-effect safety, and requested-versus-effective provider disclosure are not defined in this capsule.

candidate_findings.summary: Deterministic escalation and resurfacing are declared without deterministic transitions or thresholds.
candidate_findings.obligation: Unresolved blockers must progress through the escalation ladder and age according to thresholds that raise attention and resurface help.
candidate_findings.gap: No threshold values, clocks, transition guards, reset conditions, reassignment behavior, or escalation evidence are given. Dismissal is presentation-only and cannot create fake health, yet dismissal is also listed as an endpoint for resurfacing, leaving visibility of an active dismissed blocker unresolved.

candidate_findings.summary: SparseNgramIndex correctness depends on unspecified candidate-generation behavior.
candidate_findings.obligation: Instant Grep must transparently accelerate regex search while preserving final correctness through candidate narrowing, dirty-path verification, and ripgrep confirmation.
candidate_findings.gap: The capsule does not define content normalization, sparse-n-gram extraction, minimal-cover selection, unsupported-regex fallback, xxh3 collision handling, watcher overflow recovery, or rebuild-failure behavior. Because ripgrep verifies only the narrowed candidates, false-negative prevention remains consequential builder discretion.

candidate_findings.summary: Runtime Identity persistence is asserted without a complete durable schema or lineage transition contract.
candidate_findings.obligation: Runtime identity, including requested/effective account and switch lineage, must persist across retries and restarts and be consumed rather than redefined by UI surfaces.
candidate_findings.gap: The capsule uses non-exhaustive `including` wording and does not define required fields, nullability, serialization, initial lineage, append rules, failed-switch recording, retry account behavior, or restart rehydration evidence.

candidate_findings.obligation: Mutable runtime truth must remain outside plan shards and use the canonical SessionStore/projection boundary.
candidate_findings.gap: One rule says runtime truth lives in events, JSON sidecars, and projection docs, while SessionStore later forbids project-local JSON sidecars and directs truth to seglog, redb, and projections. The capsule never identifies which non-project-local sidecars remain allowed, their authority, or whether the earlier sidecar wording is retired.

candidate_findings.summary: The relationship between project activity and Projects-page Orchestrator status is unspecified.
candidate_findings.obligation: Project-facing runtime status must use stable, distinguishable state axes across cards, inspectors, and help surfaces.
candidate_findings.gap: Projects cards expose `idle|running|paused`, while project `activity_state` uses `planning|running|waiting|blocked|cooling_down|archived`. The capsule supplies no derivation, coexistence, precedence, or display rule, including how blocked or cooling-down activity maps to the card status.

explicit_non_gaps.statement: Platform naming is closed: `Puppet Master` is canonical and older names may only be described as `legacy naming`.
Persona identity fields are exactly `requested_persona` and `effective_persona`; `_id` substitutes are migration aliases, and protected core Personas are immutable and non-deletable.
Provider-layer capability/routing vocabulary is explicitly distinct from runtime identity, and bare `/web` performs no default operation.
Local Git/worktree behavior belongs to Source Control, while hosted workflow/admin/runtime behavior belongs to GitHub Actions.
Terminal presentation, tab layout, pane binding, PTY continuity, and higher-level development workflow identity are explicitly separate concepts.
Usage-pressure state is explicitly separate from general health and final resolution outcome.
The glossary forbids flattening freshness, health, and write availability into one offline badge and requires under-specified mutation commands to block.
Dismissal is presentation state rather than semantic resolution, and an active blocker may not be dismissed into fake health.
Requested/effective copy has mandated labels and forbidden synonyms, and retry, resume, recover, and restore have distinct meanings.
Secrets are forbidden from SessionStore and may persist only in an OS-backed credential store.

Search ownership is explicit: regex file-content matching belongs to `grep`, keyword/snippet/symbol retrieval belongs to `codesearch`, File Manager search is a tree filter, and LSP surfaces retain their own semantics.
Consumers may add richer examples or workflow copy but must preserve glossary-owned terms and negative constraints.

unknowns.statement: Whether cited owner contracts resolve the capsule-local gaps is unknown.
unknowns.reason: The capsule contains ContractRefs to routing, GUI, storage, command, permission, and Orchestrator owners but not their contract text.

unknowns.statement: Which projection-policy fields become audit-visible and what constitutes sufficient owner proof are unknown.
unknowns.reason: The fields default to internal visibility unless an owner doc proves otherwise, but no proof authority, artifact, or decision procedure is defined here.

unknowns.statement: The lifecycle and isolation mechanics of each account-scoped `CODEX_HOME` sandbox are unknown.
unknowns.reason: The capsule promises account separation and residue isolation but does not state creation, permissions, concurrency, cleanup, retention, or failure behavior.

unknowns.statement: Artifact identity and ordering under timestamp collisions are unknown.
unknowns.reason: Artifacts are indexed by concern, route target, type, and timestamp, but timestamp precision, uniqueness, stable artifact ID, collision handling, and ordering rules are not stated.

unknowns.statement: The complete acceptance and validation metadata for G-002 are unknown.
unknowns.reason: The bounded context shows accepted status, GUI classification, split disposition, and dependencies only; no validation, risk, or evidence fields appear within lines 302-313.

unknowns.statement: Browser-handoff cancellation and failure outcomes are unknown.
unknowns.reason: The prescribed happy path covers pause, focus, attention state, resume, and retry but does not state timeout, user cancellation, lost-tab, invalidated-session, or failed-focus transitions.
